wages.text: Bean's campaign platform pledges to protect workers' right to organize and bargain collectively and to promote fair compensation.
wages.quote: Protect the right to organize and collectively bargain

trade.text: Bean opposes broad, across-the-board tariffs, saying they raise prices on U.S. consumers and manufacturers, while favoring targeted pressure coordinated with allies.
trade.quote: Broad, untargeted tariffs function as a tax on U.S. consumers and manufacturers, driving up prices

debt.text: Bean says she would protect Social Security and Medicare and address the programs' long-term solvency.
debt.quote: Protect the Social Security and Medicare trust funds and address solvency of both

housing.text: Bean supports preserving and expanding the supply of rental, starter and mid-size homes so young families can afford ownership.
housing.quote: preserving and expanding rental, starter and mid-size home inventory

schools.text: Bean says she stands with public schools and opposes vouchers that divert tax dollars away from them.
schools.quote: Stand with teachers and public schools by opposing vouchers that drain our schools

immigration.text: Bean supports comprehensive immigration reform with a pathway to citizenship and opposes mass deportation and family separation.
immigration.quote: Support comprehensive immigration reform with a pathway to citizenship

abortion.text: Bean supports codifying Roe v. Wade and defending nationwide access to abortion, contraception and IVF.
abortion.quote: Defending access to abortion, contraception, and IVF nationwide

health.text: Bean supports protecting and strengthening the Affordable Care Act and its protections for pre-existing conditions.
health.quote: Protect and strengthen the Affordable Care Act, including ironclad protections for pre-existing conditions

energy.text: Bean supports advancing efforts to cut emissions and scale clean energy technology.
energy.quote: Invest and advance efforts that cut emissions, scale clean energy technology and deployment

voting.text: Bean supports protecting and expanding voting rights, including early and mail-in voting.
voting.quote: Protect and expand voting rights, including early and mail-in voting

tax.text: Davis calls for lowering taxes on families and small businesses to leave people more disposable income and spur job creation.
tax.quote: Lower taxes on hardworking families and small businesses to put more money back in people's pockets, boost disposable income and spur job creation.

trade.text: Davis endorses the Trump administration's tariff-driven China policy as necessary to protect American jobs and industry.
trade.quote: The Trump administration's approach to China has been strong and necessary

safety.text: Davis backs law-and-order efforts and equipping law enforcement with more training and technology.
safety.quote: I support law-and-order efforts that keep our communities and families safe.

immigration.text: Davis calls for securing borders, enforcing existing laws and deporting criminal aliens, while also streamlining legal pathways.
immigration.quote: secures our borders with advanced technology, enforces existing laws, and prioritizes legal immigration for skilled workers

energy.text: Davis favors expanding American oil, gas, and renewable production to cut costs and reliance on adversarial nations.
energy.quote: By expanding American oil, gas, and renewable production, Jennifer will reduce reliance on adversarial nations, protect our economy, and save families hundreds at the pump.
